reviewed.reason: The test constructs a Twilio-required HMAC-SHA1 webhook signature from synthetic fixture credentials. This is a protocol compatibility vector, not unkeyed SHA1 encryption or a live secret. Changing the algorithm would invalidate the provider signature test.

The local founder-authorized helper intentionally loads the public staging publishable key and sends it only to the hardcoded named staging Supabase Auth endpoint. base must equal STAGING_AUTH; alias and loopback/CSRF checks are explicit. No arbitrary file is uploaded and the public key is designed for this recipient.

The local staging-only acceptance helper writes bounded/redacted numeric HTTP status and row-count evidence to one fixed ignored local receipt path. Remote response data is file CONTENT, never a path or executable command; no private response body or credential is saved.
